text:
erin: Heads-up: starting planning thread for the "tenant-overlap-surge-protection" rollout. Goal: enable tenant-aware traffic steering with automatic fallback tiers. Need quick product/ops alignment on canaries, overlap handling when tenants span regions, and experiment criteria.

tim: Suggest we avoid per-request A/B due to noisy signal. Use per-tenant bucketing and reserve a deterministic overflow bucket for multi-region tenants.

nora: From SRE: overlap behavior is tricky. If a tenant has active sessions in two regions, prefer sticky routing unless a region is unhealthy. Define session affinity TTL and a failover policy.

kevin: Product asks: include a dark-launch phase for 72h, then manual-exempt tenants, then 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% ramps. Keep stabilization windows at 48h between ramps.

jira-bot: JIRA issue created: PROJ-7821 "tenant-overlap-surge-protection rollout" assigned to @tim.

erin: Proposed success metrics: routing stability (session stickiness %), customer error rate delta, end-to-end latency P95, and corrective fallback frequency. Primary metric: routing stability for enterprise tenants.

tim: Add failure thresholds: fallback frequency > 3% over baseline for 1h, P95 latency increase >20% sustained 30m, or 2xx success rate drop >10% in 15m -> auto rollback.

nora: Runbook snippet:
- preflight: validate affinity TTL, ensure sticky headers present.
- dark-launch (no external effect) 72h: collect mismatch and telemetry.
- manual-exempt bucket (up to 8 tenants).
- start canary.

kevin: For A/B testing we’ll create an "experience" tag. Customers in manual bucket get opt-in UI toggle and telemetry view.

erin: Data retention: keep dark-launch logs 10d, sampling for quality checks 60d. PII redaction required before storage.

tim: Implementation detail: flag: tenant_overlap_protection_v1 rules: manual_bucket (tenants[]), random_tenant_percent: 0.5, fallback_order: [model_variant, region_failover, degrade_to_queued].

nora: Please add an emergency mute endpoint for noisy telemetry to avoid alert storms.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window Wed 03:00-05:00 PT, will auto-run preflight smoke tests.

kevin: Marketing/CS note: prepare templated message for manual opt-in tenants outlining rollback SLA and contact in case of issues.

erin: I'll draft the rollout checklist and upload to the confluence page. Tim to PR the flag and tests. Nora to add circuit-breaker hooks.

jira-bot: Linked PROJ-7821 -> DOCS-429 for opt-in docs.

erin: final Qs: do we want canary per tenant-group (by region) or global sample? Tim: per region groups to isolate regional infra variance.

kevin: Agree. Let's avoid global mixing early on.

erin: Thanks team. I'll circulate the finalized schedule and checklist by EOD. :eyes:
